caption: Fig B – New L2: 3×3 neighbor cell search. Query q is Morton-encoded to find its cell (i,j, blue). All 9 surrounding cells are checked (orange). Green elements undergo point-in-tet test.
description: 2D visualization of the 3x3 neighbor cell search in the new L2 method. Query position is encoded to a Morton key, resolves to center cell, then all 9 (3x3) neighboring cells are searched for point-in-tet check.
